intro.text: A mountain range in Opelon, called the Dathreki Mountains by the Fjordell.
A mountain range in Opelon along the border between Arelon and Fjorden, called the Dathreki Mountains by the Fjordell.

description.text: For many years the range stopped the Derethi from invading Arelon, a barrier that deepened their hatred of the Arelene.
The range is one of Arelon's chief geographical features, and its curve is echoed in the right side of Aon Aon.
